task.title: Tick-type-aware deterministic fallback mappings for T3/T5/T6/T7/T8
task.objective: Extract the deferred-tick fallback logic from the generic else-branch in AppraisalOutput.from_deterministic_fallback into a dedicated module that maps each of T3, T5, T6, T7, and T8 to an explicit, individually documented AppraisalOutput. Each mapping must be independently testable and must produce a valid AppraisalOutput that passes all existing AppraisalOutput model validators.
task.exact_scope: Create one new Python module under back/app/engines/ (or back/app/domain/) that houses tick-type-aware fallback mapping functions for the five deferred tick types (self_initiated_action, emotional_shift, learning_work, player_influence, reflection). Update AppraisalOutput.from_deterministic_fallback to delegate the deferred-tick branch to these named mappings rather than a single anonymous else block. Add a dedicated test file under back/tests/ that covers each of the five tick types individually with at minimum 2 assertions per tick type. No other files are in scope.
acceptance_criteria: A new module exists (e.g., back/app/engines/deterministic_fallback.py or back/app/domain/deterministic_fallback.py) that contains five individually named functions or a mapping dict, one per deferred tick type (T3, T5, T6, T7, T8), each returning a valid AppraisalOutput.
AppraisalOutput.from_deterministic_fallback delegates the deferred-tick branch to the new module's per-tick logic, eliminating the anonymous else block for those five types.
A dedicated test file back/tests/test_p29_t3_deferred_fallback.py exists and contains at least 10 test functions covering all five deferred tick types.
For each of the five deferred tick types, at least one test asserts absorption==AbsorptionLevel.none.
For each of the five deferred tick types, at least one test asserts fallback_used is True.
For each of the five deferred tick types, at least one test asserts the output tick_type advisory field matches the input tick type.
For each of the five deferred tick types, at least one test asserts narrative_summary is a non-empty string containing a tick-type identifier.
For each of the five deferred tick types, at least one test asserts confidence==1.0.
All 5 deferred fallback outputs pass AppraisalOutput model validation without raising ValidationError.
All existing tests continue to pass — no regressions.
Running python -m pytest back/tests/ -v exits with code 0.
required_tests: T3 fallback echoes self_initiated_action in the tick_type advisory field
T3 fallback narrative_summary is non-empty and identifies the tick type
T5 fallback echoes emotional_shift in the tick_type advisory field
T5 fallback narrative_summary is non-empty and identifies the tick type
T6 fallback echoes learning_work in the tick_type advisory field
T6 fallback narrative_summary is non-empty and identifies the tick type
T7 fallback echoes player_influence in the tick_type advisory field
T7 fallback narrative_summary is non-empty and identifies the tick type
T8 fallback echoes reflection in the tick_type advisory field
T8 fallback narrative_summary is non-empty and identifies the tick type
Calling from_deterministic_fallback with any of the five deferred tick types produces a valid AppraisalOutput that passes all Pydantic validators without raising ValidationError
The deferred fallback outputs for all five tick types are distinguishable by their narrative_summary strings (no two deferred ticks share the same narrative_summary)
non_goals: Do not wire the fallback outputs into any engine settlement or tick bridge path.
Do not activate live appraisal authority for any deferred tick type.
Do not expand the AppraisalSignal v1 schema.
Do not add prompt engineering, LLM calls, or any non-deterministic logic.
Do not modify existing test files.
Do not modify decisions.md, vision.md, road_map.md, or any orchestrator file.
Do not change the AppraisalInput or AppraisalOutput field definitions.
Do not add growth contributions or aftershock to any deferred tick fallback.
Do not add relational blocks to T3/T5/T6/T8 fallback outputs.
Do not produce a frontend change of any kind.
constraints: All five deferred tick types must each have an individually named, documented fallback mapping — no shared catch-all else branch may remain for T3/T5/T6/T7/T8.
Every fallback output for a deferred tick must set absorption=AbsorptionLevel.none, growth=[], aftershock_days=0, and fallback_used=True.
Every fallback output must echo the correct tick_type in the advisory tick_type field.
Every fallback output must have confidence=1.0 (fully deterministic).
narrative_summary for each tick type must be a non-empty string that names the tick type, so log consumers can distinguish outputs without parsing enum values.
No bridge expansion for deferred ticks — these mappings are schema accommodation only; no new AppraisalSignal wiring, no engine settlement path changes.
AppraisalSignal v1 must not be modified.
The AppraisalInput model must not be modified.
The AppraisalOutput model fields and validators must not be modified (the from_deterministic_fallback body may be updated to delegate; no field changes).

HARD GATE — SOT MUTATION FORBIDDEN: decisions.md, vision.md, road_map.md, and any file under the orchestrator directory must not be read for editing and must not be written, appended, or otherwise mutated. Any modification to these files is an immediate hard gate failure regardless of content.
No LLM runtime integration — all logic is purely deterministic Python.
Do not modify any existing test file; only add new test files.
Do not add new enums or new domain fields beyond what is needed for the fallback module.
